snippet.title: Contact Protocol - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

You’re the security officer aboard the GalCo mining ship Pale Horse on its way to Jupiter’s largest moon. Your job is to check approaching ships against company records and decide whether each one is a friend or a foe. This starship job simulator is set in a gritty cassette-futurist world, and it ends by giving you a moral profile you can share. It launches in spring 2027.
